title: FB-017 sanitize cluster log display fields
summary: Fixed FR-001 by normalizing CR/LF and other control characters in cluster-log display fields before formatting one physical log row.
reason: Worker finding W01-001 showed authenticated worker-supplied log fields could inject extra physical lines into cluster.log.
behavior_before: Worker-supplied timestamp, worker name, role, level, event, message, source path, and worker timestamp fields could carry CR/LF/control characters into cluster.log formatting.
behavior_after: The /api/log sanitizer and formatter defensively replace control characters with spaces, collapse repeated spaces, and keep existing length bounds so each event renders as one physical line.

rollback_plan: Revert the cluster-log sanitizer/formatter changes and the two regression tests, then rerun the listed network validation commands.
notes: No media, queue, publish, rename, settings, or source/output/scratch mutation behavior changed. Sanitized control characters are preserved as spaces so diagnostic text remains recognizable without allowing line injection.
